explain.title: How this works.

body.rep: You raise the request; the coordinator builds the real quotation in SMAC and gets it signed, then accepts it here and sends you the PDF. When the customer pays, you confirm the payment — that is what unlocks dispatch. The coordinator records what actually left the warehouse.
body.coordinator: The rep raises the request; you build the real quotation in SMAC and get it signed, then accept it here and send the PDF back. The rep confirms the payment — that is what unlocks dispatch. You record what actually left the warehouse.
